# 00000002205

**MI-05 ★** — source: 59_交换环与乘法理想论.md

**English.** Definition: A Nagata star operation is a star operation induced by a multiplicative subset. Conjecture: Every finite star operation is generated by at most a power of two of minimal-prime Nagata compositions; and the minimal number of generators is attained on semigroup rings. (star operation Nagata generation bound)

**中文。** 定义：Nagata 星操作指由乘性子集诱导的星操作。猜想：每个有限星操作恒由不超过二的极小素数次幂个 Nagata 复合生成；且生成的最小数在半群环上达到。（星操作 Nagata 生成界）
